description: Na₆Ta₄Zn₂Si₆(SO₁₂)₃ crystallizes in the trigonal P3c1 space group. There are four inequivalent Na sites. In the first Na site, Na is bonded in a 8-coordinate geometry to eight O atoms. There are a spread of Na-O bond distances ranging from 2.37-3.00 Å. In the second Na site, Na is bonded in a distorted hexagonal planar geometry to six O atoms. There are three shorter (2.48 Å) and three longer (2.73 Å) Na-O bond lengths. In the third Na site, Na is bonded in a distorted hexagonal planar geometry to six O atoms. There are three shorter (2.45 Å) and three longer (2.70 Å) Na-O bond lengths. In the fourth Na site, Na is bonded in a distorted hexagonal planar geometry to six O atoms. There are three shorter (2.54 Å) and three longer (2.62 Å) Na-O bond lengths. There are four inequivalent Ta sites. In the first Ta site, Ta is bonded to six O atoms to form TaO₆ octahedra that share corners with three equivalent SiO₄ tetrahedra and corners with three equivalent SO₄ tetrahedra. There are three shorter (1.89 Å) and three longer (2.16 Å) Ta-O bond lengths. In the second Ta site, Ta is bonded to six O atoms to form TaO₆ octahedra that share corners with six SiO₄ tetrahedra. There are three shorter (1.94 Å) and three longer (2.08 Å) Ta-O bond lengths. In the third Ta site, Ta is bonded to six O atoms to form TaO₆ octahedra that share corners with six SiO₄ tetrahedra. There are three shorter (1.96 Å) and three longer (1.98 Å) Ta-O bond lengths. In the fourth Ta site, Ta is bonded to six O atoms to form TaO₆ octahedra that share corners with three equivalent SiO₄ tetrahedra and corners with three equivalent SO₄ tetrahedra. There are three shorter (1.90 Å) and three longer (2.15 Å) Ta-O bond lengths. There are two inequivalent Zn sites. In the first Zn site, Zn is bonded to six O atoms to form ZnO₆ octahedra that share corners with three equivalent SiO₄ tetrahedra and corners with three equivalent SO₄ tetrahedra. There are three shorter (2.07 Å) and three longer (2.13 Å) Zn-O bond lengths. In the second Zn site, Zn is bonded in a distorted trigonal non-coplanar geometry to six O atoms. There are three shorter (1.90 Å) and three longer (2.51 Å) Zn-O bond lengths. There are two inequivalent Si sites. In the first Si site, Si is bonded to four O atoms to form SiO₄ tetrahedra that share corners with three TaO₆ octahedra. The corner-sharing octahedral tilt angles range from 25-30°. There are a spread of Si-O bond distances ranging from 1.57-1.69 Å. In the second Si site, Si is bonded to four O atoms to form SiO₄ tetrahedra that share  a cornercorner with one ZnO₆ octahedra and corners with three TaO₆ octahedra. The corner-sharing octahedral tilt angles range from 21-38°. There are a spread of Si-O bond distances ranging from 1.61-1.69 Å. S is bonded to four O atoms to form SO₄ tetrahedra that share  a cornercorner with one ZnO₆ octahedra and corners with two TaO₆ octahedra. The corner-sharing octahedral tilt angles range from 17-40°. There are a spread of S-O bond distances ranging from 1.45-1.54 Å. There are twelve inequivalent O sites. In the first O site, O is bonded in a 3-coordinate geometry to one Na, one Zn, and one S atom. In the second O site, O is bonded in a distorted linear geometry to one Ta and one S atom. In the third O site, O is bonded in a distorted bent 120 degrees geometry to one Zn and one Si atom. In the fourth O site, O is bonded in a distorted bent 150 degrees geometry to one Na, one Ta, and one Si atom. In the fifth O site, O is bonded in a distorted bent 150 degrees geometry to one Na, one Ta, and one Si atom. In the sixth O site, O is bonded in a bent 150 degrees geometry to one Na, one Ta, and one Si atom. In the seventh O site, O is bonded to three Na, one Zn, and one Si atom to form distorted face-sharing ONa₃ZnSi trigonal bipyramids. In the eighth O site, O is bonded in a distorted bent 150 degrees geometry to one Na, one Ta, and one Si atom. In the ninth O site, O is bonded in a 3-coordinate geometry to one Na, one Zn, and one S atom. In the tenth O site, O is bonded in a 5-coordinate geometry to three Na, one Ta, and one Si atom. In the eleventh O site, O is bonded in a 3-coordinate geometry to one Na, one Ta, and one Si atom. In the twelfth O site, O is bonded in a 3-coordinate geometry to one Na, one Ta, and one S atom.
